controls.requirement: The clean-room oracle must not import or call candidate code or prior notebook evaluators.
The candidate adapter must remain REFERENCE_STANDIN unless the exact governed frozen candidate is inserted under human review.
A PASS_BOUNDED_EQUIVALENCE outcome is forbidden unless adapter mode is GOVERNED_FROZEN_CANDIDATE.
Every disagreement, invariant failure, replay mismatch, and independence breach must be preserved.
The corpus uses new seeds and does not load prior row-level expected labels.
The formal-oracle capture hash and notebook hash must be verified before execution.
